source.title: 11233: Partifinansiering, etter regnskapspost, politisk parti, statistikkvariabel og år
source.note: Annual party accounts as reported to SSB. No field measures anonymous donations; A.3.5 is a residual for uncategorised givers and must not be read as an anonymity count.

posts.A.3.5: Bidrag fra andre, ikke kategoriserte givere

source.name: Statsforvalteren, register over bidrag etter partiloven
source.note: Contributions above the statutory threshold, as reported by the parties. Not the same measure as SSB 11233 A.3 and never added to it. Donor-level rows are not included: the register's paginated endpoint answers 500 for every parameter shape tried, so the site's own table could not be reproduced; this block holds the published aggregates.
